headline: Uzbekistan obliges foreign marketplaces to register for tax purposes in the country
summary: President Shavkat Mirziyoyev approved amendments to the Tax Code requiring foreign marketplaces to register for tax purposes in Uzbekistan. The aim is to strengthen regulation of e-commerce.
why: Tax registration rules shape how global e-commerce platforms collect and remit taxes in new markets, affecting their compliance costs.
